result:
All checks pass, here's a summary of what was built:

**Files created** (7 files):
- `index.html` - Loads Three.js 0.147.0 from CDN + all scripts in order, HUD overlay
- `person.js` - Person mesh factory with leg/arm pivots, walk/sit animation, nose for facing direction, 3 color palettes (20 shirts, 10 skin tones, 10 pants)
- `world.js` - 6-floor office building with semi-transparent walls, entrance gap on floor 0, 4 offices/floor, conference room, lounge, lobby with cafe/bistro/lounge/pit/reception/kiosk, navigation graph + BFS pathfinding, call panels with glowing arrows, shaft indicators
- `elevator_logic.js` - Pure state machine (IDLE/MOVING/DOOR_OPENING/DOOR_OPEN/DOOR_CLOSING), SCAN scheduling, anti-starvation, capacity 4, spot reservation, dual-environment (browser + Node)
- `elevator.js` - Three.js elevator car with sliding doors, destination buttons, in-car indicator, adapter around ElevatorLogic
- `sim.js` - Simulated clock, day/night lighting (dawn/day/dusk/night), 100 agents (20 workers + 80 visitors), visitor top-up scheduler, action dispatch system, collision resolution, stall recovery, entrance threshold advancement
- `elevator_logic_test.js` - 7 deterministic Node tests, all passing

**Check results**: static check OK, runtime check OK (canvas, 975 objects, animation frames), elevator logic 7/7 tests passed, no `import`/`export`/`file://` violations.
